editions.notice: A machine translation made by this project with Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5) on 13 November 2026, from Karl Müller's text of the fragments (Fragmenta Historicorum Graecorum III, 1849). Most of these fragments are other writers reporting Dexippus; where Müller gives a Latin writer, the English is translated from that Latin. It is not a translator's work: check it against the Greek, and report errors. Public domain (CC0): reuse it freely.
